title: Pip Built a Copy Machine. Now There Are Nine Bolts.
altTitles: Too Many Bolts | Stick Figure Mini-Movie
Never Let Pip Build a Copy Machine
description: Pip built a copy machine to make the quest faster. Now there are nine Bolts. #stickfigure #animation #INKLIGHT
topic: L06 F1 escalating-rules comedy: Pip's copy machine, 1 tiny copy → 9 Bolts → stampede

sections.label: S1 Hook: nine Bolts
sections.videoPrompt: Cinematic 3D animated film. The characters are stylized stick figures: glossy matte-black ink bodies with uniform thin cylindrical limbs, perfectly round glossy black heads with no facial features at all except two small glowing oval eye-dots (no mouth, no nose), and a thin emissive rim light in each character's signature color. They are set inside a hyper-detailed, physically lit 3D environment with volumetric light shafts, atmospheric haze, real materials, shallow depth of field and film-grade color grading. BOLT: an average-height black ink stick figure with a round glossy head, electric cyan (#22D3EE) glowing eyes and rim light, a long flowing cyan scarf that trails light when moving. PIP: a short, small black ink stick figure (half BOLT's height) with a round glossy head, amber (#FFB020) glowing eyes and rim light, oversized brass aviator goggles on the forehead, a boxy amber backpack with antennae. In a bright candy-colored campsite, a boxy amber copy machine with a big glass lens flashes white, and nine identical copies of Bolt stand in a neat row, all waving in unison, their cyan scarves fluttering in sync; Pip stands frozen in the foreground beside the machine. Locked-off wide shot, static camera, 35mm, bright saturated daylight. Avoid: text, letters, numbers, logos, mouths, noses, teeth, human faces, skin, hair, clothing beyond the listed accessories, extra limbs, fused or merged bodies, fingers except three rounded nubs in close-ups, blood, gore, flat or empty backgrounds.

The characters are stylized stick figures: glossy matte-black ink bodies with uniform thin cylindrical limbs, perfectly round glossy black heads with no facial features at all except two small glowing oval eye-dots (no mouth, no nose), and a thin emissive rim light in each character's signature color. They are set inside a hyper-detailed, physically lit 3D environment with volumetric light shafts, atmospheric haze, real materials, shallow depth of field and film-grade color grading. PIP: a short, small black ink stick figure (half BOLT's height) with a round glossy head, amber (#FFB020) glowing eyes and rim light, oversized brass aviator goggles on the forehead, a boxy amber backpack with antennae. Close on Pip's boxy amber backpack at dusk: the flap lifts and a thumb-sized miniature copy of Bolt (a tiny black ink stick figure with electric cyan glowing eyes, cyan rim light and a tiny cyan scarf) pops out and waves; Pip turns his head, eyes widening into circles. Close-up, 85mm, warm dusk light. Avoid: text, letters, numbers, logos, mouths, noses, teeth, human faces, skin, hair, clothing beyond the listed accessories, extra limbs, fused or merged bodies, fingers except three rounded nubs in close-ups, blood, gore, flat or empty backgrounds.

lines.text: The page isn't finished. Neither are we.

qc: L06: Drift — all Bolt copies share scarf, cyan and height; no copy gets goggles or a staff (accessory bleed from refs); the mini-Brick is lime with a visor; the S11 mini-Bolt is thumb-sized. Limbs — S5/S8 crowds: tangled scarves reading as limbs; fused Bolts in the dogpile (≤2 frames, hidden by a punch-in, or reject). Faces — S10 dusk 2-shot close-ups; S3 cradling moment. Style — bubblegum palette still 3D-lit (not flat 2D); the map stays blank (no fake text). Seams — S5 at 30s/60s: clone count roughly stable (8–10 visible OK; sudden 15 = reject); S8: map position across seams; S6: lineup order holds across 30s. Text — map, blueprints and machine panels unmarked; the '#1–#9' tags are Remotion only. Gag timing — S6 unison sync is critical (re-roll if clones desync); ≥1.5s silence before the real Bolt's 'Sorry' (S7 22s). S4 end frame must match S1's lineup wide (it stands in for the 2s 'NOW' match cut). Global gate (brief §0.3): accent hue shift >6 frames / missing accessory / size swap = re-roll; 3rd limb or fused limb ≥3 frames = re-roll; any mouth, nose, teeth, brows, skin or human face even 1 frame = reject; flat/white/empty bg, 2D look, lost rim light or blood = re-roll; stitch seam at 30s: position jump >5% width, lighting flip, prop changing hands, screen-direction reversal = regenerate the later segment; any legible or pseudo-glyph text in a plate = mask or re-roll (all real text is Remotion labels). Check sourceSpec width/height/duration every clip.
